reason: The plugin is presented as a DeepSeek Harness media helper that adds image-handling to text-only LLM models by converting attached images into text descriptions (via a vision model or OCR) and sending rewritten requests while preserving the user-visible image content in session UI and logs.

summaries.zh: dsh-vision 是 DeepSeek Harness 的一个插件，让不支持图片输入的文本模型在提交图片消息时，先将图片转换为文字说明后再调用模型，从而实现更稳定的图片兼容处理。
summaries.en: dsh-vision is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets text-only models accept image-attached requests by turning images into text descriptions with vision or OCR before the model call.

capabilities: Rewrites llm request payloads so image inputs are converted to text before provider calls
Uses alternate vision-capable models or local/system OCR as a fallback to describe images
Modifies model modality handling by adding image capability to text-only models during resolution

reasons.code: README states the plugin enables text-only models to work with image attachments by describing images and replacing image blocks with generated text for provider calls.
README explains Auto/指定模型 modes and system OCR fallback (Vision framework/Windows OCR/Tesseract), confirming media transformation and fallback behavior are central.
Repository description says it gives models in DeepSeek that cannot see images a pair of eyes, directly indicating image-capability augmentation.
